characters.summary: Greatest craftsman of the Noldor, maker of the Silmarils; led the Noldor into exile under his Oath.

techniques: Renowned warrior and the greatest craftsman of the Elves
Made the Silmarils and the palantíri; devised the Tengwar

weaknesses: Overmastering pride and rashness
